prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup edit, high-fidelity desktop application screenshot.
REFERENCE ROLES: Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and authoritative visual identity: the Russian app "Фолио", with warm cream and olive colors, editorial serif headings, clear sans-serif UI text, thin rules, and a source/question spread. Image 2 is a STRUCTURAL REFERENCE ONLY for its left application navigation. Do NOT copy the brand Атлас, petrol colors, orange button, oversized textarea, extra numbering or card containers from image 2.
REQUEST: Show exactly how Фолио will look with an EXPANDED COLLAPSIBLE LEFT SIDEBAR modeled structurally on image 2. This is one coherent future UI screen, not a presentation board and not side-by-side states. Landscape desktop 1536x1024, flat straight-on, no browser frame. Preserve the Folio visual world and all content/functions of image 1.
LAYOUT:
- Replace the whole horizontal masthead navigation of image 1 with a 232px wide LEFT sidebar filling the full height. Sidebar is warm pale beige #f0ece3, hairline right border, no shadow.
- Sidebar top: elegant serif wordmark "Фолио" and small descriptor "Исследования по документам" wrapping if necessary. At its upper-right corner add an obvious square panel-collapse control, icon a small outlined panel with a left-pointing chevron; this button collapses the sidebar. Keep it within the sidebar and visibly clickable.
- Below brand: active "Документы" with document outline icon and pale sage active background plus slim olive left indicator; then "Исследования" with search outline icon. Match the placement, clarity, and spacing of the Atlas menu, using Folio colors.
- Separator and muted group heading "Временно недоступно"; four disabled entries "Доказательная база", "Каталог источников", "Проверка опытов", "Контроль ТЗ" with quiet outline icons. Bottom sidebar: "Synapse · Готов к запуску" and "Демонстрационные данные".
- NO horizontal navigation remains at the top of the content; NO duplicate tabs, account, settings, avatar or invented features.
- Main content begins to the right of the sidebar with 32px gutters and is a warm-white single working plane, NOT boxed dashboard cards.
- Top main page title "Исследование по документам" in the exact calm serif voice of Folio but sensibly sized around 40px to fit the reduced width. Subtitle "Выберите источники и задайте исследовательский вопрос." A thin rule underneath.
- Below: same two adjacent content columns as Folio, left sources about43%, right question about57%, separated by one thin vertical rule. Section headings italic serif: "Источники" and "Исследовательский вопрос". Same pale cream ground and dark readable text. Controls all sans-serif with about6px radius, no gradients.
- Sources column action "+ Добавить документы" outline, text "Выбрано 3 из 6", small selection controls "Выбрать все" and "Снять выбор". Exactly 6 compact rows, first 3 checked, all visible, 2-line file layout when needed:
"Обзор методов очистки воды.pdf" / "PDF · 42 стр."
"Результаты испытаний.csv" / "CSV · 128 строк"
"Технические требования.pdf" / "PDF · 18 стр."
"Протокол эксперимента.pdf" / "PDF · 24 стр."
"Описание оборудования.md" / "MD · 12 фрагментов"
"Библиография.bib" / "BIB · 36 записей".
Each row has checkbox left and open-original and delete outline icons at far right, safe separated click targets.
- Right column textarea about220px high, exact question "Сравните методы очистки воды по эффективности и ограничениям. На какие данные опираются выводы?"
Below it "Выбрано 3 из 6", primary olive-green button "Запустить исследование" with right arrow, secondary outlined "Найти фрагменты"; descriptive copy "Исследование подготовит ответ по выбранным источникам." and "Поиск покажет фрагменты документов." A lower thin rule and note "Результат и материалы сохранятся в разделе «Исследования»."
Keep whitespace controlled, all content readable, no text overflows. The sole new functionality illustrated is collapsing/expanding the navigation. The sidebar consumes actual layout width; it is not an overlay. This expanded state should still show all six files and both actions in first viewport. Do NOT change the selected files, the question, the product name or the Folio styling. No demo fabricated results, progress, charts, stats, new screens or marketing decorations.
